How credits work

Each agent run charges the real cost of the AI model plus a 30 % to 40 % fee, depending on the pack. The amounts above are estimates for typical runs; you follow every charge on the statement. Unused credits roll over to the next month. You set a daily limit per project, and the agent stops when the balance runs out, with no extra charge.

Annual billing: 2 months free on the subscription.
